implementation: shared SQLite connection for Product Builder event log and ContextSnapshot store
atomic checkpoint transaction for checkpoint event, ContextSnapshot, snapshot-created event and idempotency row
reopen and replay skips previously persisted checkpoint keys
HTTP Product Builder preview reads the same persisted state and reports replay counts
typed SQLite entity persistence for Handoff, ApprovalRequest, Source, Artifact and ProviderReceipt
replay guard prevents newly generated Product Builder artifacts from duplicating persisted rows
limitations: Project, BotProfile and Skill typed repositories are not implemented yet; their schema tables exist.
HTTP coverage currently verifies Product Builder preview and replay, not every create/approve/retry/cancel route against persisted domain rows.
MemoryItem typed write is supported by the repository but Product Builder has no memory input in this workflow; JSONL import/export and long-running scale validation remain pending.
This is persistence and replay evidence, not model-quality or real-world productivity evidence.
